full_name: Bryna Goodman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 History Joy Foundation Fellow University of Oregon
bio: Bryna Goodman is a professor of history at the University of Oregon. She is interested in modern Chinese urban culture, especially gender, colonialism, and new disciplinary formations. Her recent work examines early-20th-century Chinese print culture to map the interplay between everyday life and globally circulating institutions and categories of knowledge.
